card.name: Verbs after "should" in advice sentences
card.fires_on: The word "be" after "should" in monitoring or advising instructions, and the lifestyle advice words ("maintaining", the comma after "regular exercise") in the statin blood sugar warning.

modes.label: Should be monitored/advised
modes.description: The word "be" right after "should" in a patient-instruction sentence.
modes.example: Any patient treated with LYBALVI should<< be>> monitored for symptoms of hyperglycemia

modes.label: Lifestyle advice list
modes.description: Comma or verb in the list of healthy-living measures after "regular exercise".
modes.example: Optimize lifestyle measures, including regular exercise,<< maintaining>> a healthy body weight, and making healthy

card.plain: It marks the point in a warning where the text moves into advice to monitor, advise or live healthily.
evidence: Any patient treated with LYBALVI should<< be>> monitored for symptoms of hyperglycemia
Optimize lifestyle measures, including regular exercise,<< maintaining>> a healthy body weight, and making healthy
Women of childbearing potential should<< be>> advised to avoid becoming pregnant.
